name: Convert a Word DOCX file to PDF
description: Verifies a DOCX document is converted into a downloadable PDF.
steps: Choose Word to PDF
Upload a valid DOCX file containing text
Choose Convert now
Download the resulting PDF
expected: A PDF file is generated and offered as a download.

name: Convert PDF text into Word and PowerPoint
description: Verifies a text-based PDF can be exported into editable Office formats.
steps: Choose PDF to Word and upload a text-based PDF
Convert and download the DOCX
Choose PDF to PowerPoint and upload the same PDF
Convert and download the PPTX
expected: The converter provides a DOCX and a PPTX file containing extracted PDF text.

name: Convert Excel and PowerPoint files to PDF
description: Verifies spreadsheet data and presentation text can be exported as PDFs.
steps: Choose Excel to PDF and upload an XLSX workbook
Convert and download the PDF
Choose PowerPoint to PDF and upload a PPTX file
Convert and download the PDF
expected: Both Office files produce downloadable PDF documents.

name: Merge PDFs and split a PDF into page files
description: Verifies PDF utility workflows produce downloadable documents.
steps: Choose Merge PDFs and upload two PDF files
Convert and download the merged PDF
Choose Split PDF and upload a multi-page PDF
Convert and download the individual page PDFs
expected: A merged PDF and one PDF file per source page are available.

name: Reject unsupported files and use the converter on mobile
description: Verifies invalid file types are rejected and image conversion works on mobile.
steps: Open the converter on mobile
Choose Word to PDF and attempt to upload a PNG image
Verify a validation message appears
Choose Images to PDF and upload a JPG image
Convert and download the PDF
expected: Unsupported files are rejected, and image-to-PDF conversion provides a downloadable PDF.
